title: Adaptive Policy Portfolios for Robust Markov Decision Processes
abstract: arXiv:2608.17929v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Robust Markov decision processes optimize one policy against a set of plausible transition functions. This can be conservative when the unknown dynamics are fixed and become partially identifiable after deployment. We study adaptive policy portfolios: finite sets of memoryless randomized policies synthesized offline and paired with a lightweight online selector. Robust regret is a natural measure of portfolio quality: for each plausible environment, it measures the loss of the best portfolio member relative to the policy that would have been optimal had that environment been known. Related regret objectives were studied by Ghavamzadeh et al. (2016) with an emphasis on approximations and relaxations for safe policy improvement. We give a complexity-theoretic account of portfolio certification and synthesis. Certifying a given portfolio is $\forall\mathbb{R}$-complete already for deterministic portfolios in acyclic (s,a)-rectangular RMDPs.

translated_title: 自适应策略组合用于鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程
translated_abstract: 鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程优化一个策略以应对一组可能的转移函数。当未知动态是固定的且在部署后变得部分可识别时，这种方法可能过于保守。我们研究自适应策略组合：有限的无记忆随机化策略集，离线合成，并配以轻量级在线选择器。鲁棒遗憾是衡量组合质量的自然指标：对于每个可能的环境，它衡量最佳组合成员相对于在该环境已知情况下本应最优的策略的损失。相关遗憾目标由Ghavamzadeh等人（2016）研究，强调安全策略改进的近似和松弛。我们对组合认证和合成进行了复杂性理论分析。在无环（s,a）-矩形RMDP中，即使对于确定性组合，认证给定组合已是$\forall\mathbb{R}$-完全问题。
tldr: 本文提出自适应策略组合方法，以鲁棒遗憾为质量指标，并证明其认证问题在无环RMDP中是∀ℝ-完全的。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces adaptive policy portfolios with robust regret as a quality metric, and proves that certifying such portfolios is ∀ℝ-complete in acyclic RMDPs.
